_comment: Mermaid config for the PNG deliverable -- the figure inserted into the TRSET
htmlLabels: true is correct here. Chrome rasterizes its own foreignObject, so the
labels the emitter produces render as intended.
fontFamily: DejaVu Sans. Pinned explicitly, never inherited from the host.
Verified present in the pinned image before every render; a family the image does
not ship is an error, because fontconfig would otherwise fall back silently and
the figure would still render with different metrics and no indication of it.
The image installs ttf-dejavu, ttf-freefont, ttf-linux-libertine, ttf-inconsolata,
securityLevel is stated rather than left default: 'loose' plus themeCSS/--cssFile
